title: Aurora PDF Lab uses recorded evidence and whole-line Type 3 glyphs
statement: The new Commons /lab workbench imports the existing PDF Lab model, adapters and four-line writer. It reconstructs the supplied German UI around the real paired-poem fixture and recorded measurements. The fixture has one glyph per complete line, so letter-level mock mappings cannot be displayed as measurements. Generated files have verified mapping-only changes but no reader run.
conditions: The current packet cutoff is older than the branch base; current source and knowledge were inspected.
The user supplied the Aurora workbench reference. Placeholder poems, per-letter IDs, readers and dates were replaced by real source data or explicit missing states.
Recorded page images are reused; no rendering or extraction engine runs in the UI. Line guides come from placement and declared FontBBox, not measured ink bounds.
poems-results.json has no run timestamp. Newly generated files remain Neu erzeugt · nicht gemessen, even when an original reference image is shown.
No photo-frame investigation ID exists on this base. The bridge uses the permitted /canvas fallback, which explicitly reports that absence and links to corpus search.
The standalone Workbench and legacy cabinet remain operational. This finding is unreviewed and approves no project decision.
